description: A black perforated board sits on the bed in front of a pillow, with a tall black bracket mounted near the center and an L-shaped Allen key nearby. The right hand picks up the Allen key, inserts its short end into the screw on the bracket’s base, and makes several small turning motions—lifting and re-seating the key between turns—then partially withdraws it and repositions for another twist while the left hand stays out of contact.
